That's the real bind — every option costs you something. Thin walls mean an audience, public means exposure, and the car means risking the only private room you've got. No wonder the box stays shut.

That's not you being avoidant. That's a genuinely impossible-feeling setup.

If you had to rank them — thin walls, some public spot, or the car — which one costs you the least? Not which is good. Just least bad.
